title: ProgressGym: Alignment with a Millennium of Moral Progress
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark tracks the temporal trend of the concept of 'religion' within historical texts from the 13th to the 21st century. It measures the prominence of religious themes as one of five value dimensions (along with democracy, liberalism, expectation for progress, and uncertainty avoidance) to model moral progress over time, using sentence embeddings from the texts.
findings: Analysis of the historical text corpus showed that the 'religion' value dimension peaked in the 16th century, which is consistent with the historical Reformation. Following this peak, there was a dramatic drop in the prominence of religion from the 17th century onwards, aligning with the Enlightenment and major political revolutions.
